agenda_text:
PARKS AND RECREATION COMMISSION AGENDA
  WEDNESDAY, APRIL 3, 2024
  2760 N. STUDEBAKER ROAD
  PARKS, RECREATION AND MARINE ADMINISTRATION
  LARGE CONFERENCE ROOM, 5:00 PM

Robert Livingstone, Chair  Sharleen Higa, Commissioner
Susan Redfield, Vice Chair  Kasey Schoen, Commissioner
Cory Allen, Commissioner  Silissa Uriarte Smith, Commissioner
Christopher Chavez, Commissioner

Brent Dennis, Director
Jennifer Roberts, Executive Assistant

  SPECIAL MEETING

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO EMAIL PUBLIC COMMENTS TO
  CHRISTINE.AMAYA@LONGBEACH.GOV

 CALL TO ORDER

 ROLL CALL

 REGULAR AGENDA

 1.  24-52847  Recommendation to approve Special Event Permit Application #24-166 from
  Partners of Parks, a California nonprofit organization, to host a fundraiser titled
  “Sowing the Seeds,” at El Dorado Nature Center on April 13, 2024, that includes
  the sale and consumption of alcohol beverages, with parameters determined by the
  Office of Special Events and Filming and the Department of Parks, Recreation and
  Marine; or

  Determine the proposed activity does not provide overall public benefit and deny
  Special Event Permit Application #24-166 from Partners of Parks, a California
  nonprofit organization, to host a fundraiser titled “Sowing the Seeds,” at El Dorado
  Nature Center. (District 4)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 PUBLIC COMMENT

 Opportunity to address the Parks and Recreation Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker
 is limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

 ANNOUNCEMENTS

 ADJOURNMENT
